faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work as a farmhouse interior designer in Karnal?

Yes. Karnal and its surrounding villages have many farmhouses, and we design them as relaxed family homes or weekend retreats.

What materials suit a farmhouse in Haryana?

Stone, solid wood, terracotta, lime plaster and cotton or linen fabrics. They handle heat and dust well and age gracefully.

Can you plan outdoor kitchens and seating?

Yes. Verandas, outdoor kitchens, fire pits and garden seating are planned along with the interiors for family gatherings.

Why hire a farmhouse interior designer instead of furnishing it yourself?

Farmhouses are large, and furniture alone does not make them comfortable. Planning layout, lighting and storage turns a big space into a usable home.
